head: codex/191-secure-durable-openraft
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16a] Secure and durably persist three-voter OpenRaft transport
body:
Closes #191

## Summary
- add a real three-voter OpenRaft substrate over mutually authenticated QUIC with signed polis sessions and authority-derived topology
- persist vote, log, state-machine, snapshot, boot-generation, and exact-retry response state with crash reconciliation and an external rollback checkpoint
- enforce bounded canonical framing, replay conflict rejection, certificate/boot rotation, idle deadlines, path safety, and deterministic snapshot identity
- repair the existing standalone transport and discovery test harnesses so hosted full-workspace compilation includes the reviewed transport authority dependencies
- provide the secure consensus substrate required by the later Guardian/kernel/Observatory operational integration children; this PR does not claim the full #142 live Wuji/AWS demonstration

## Validation
- focused secure-Raft target: 14/14 passed
- combined runtime and compatibility transport targets: 28/28 passed
- standalone transport and discovery harnesses: 27/27 passed
- full workspace compile and strict Clippy with `-D warnings`: passed
- canonical issue receipt validator and exact 14 machine-derived cases: passed
- diff hygiene: passed

## Review
Independent findings-first review approved substantive repair `fe948c207dfa2d64071bd6beac4eb4e0df415dfa` with no P0-P3 findings. The repair changes only the two compatibility harnesses and typed issue truth; protected product and immutable evidence bytes remain unchanged. Replacement hosted CI and the operator's external PR review remain required. This PR must not be merged before that external review is complete.
